analysis.label: CareerPath Analysis
analysis.disclaimer: CareerPath analysis is our interpretation of published and observed market data. It is not an official government assessment.
insights: Local delivery architecture matters because commissioning, health integration and specialist provision vary by area.
Funding and provider coverage should be considered alongside labour-market conditions and workforce availability.
As official performance data matures, trend and geography comparisons will become increasingly useful.
